title: The modern State
goal: Say how the State changed, with verbs of change.

items: I can say how something changed, with *convertirse en*, *hacerse*, *volverse* and *quedarse*.
I can say how the State and the bureaucracy grew after 1900.
I can explain what the Estado Novo was, and that historians judge this period differently.
I can use the words *la burocracia*, *el régimen*, *el ciudadano* and *el poder*.
